messages:
sasha: Quick sync — want to align runtime + platform on the new rollout/canary metrics for the compare dashboards. TL;DR: we need consistent signal names, agreed sample rates, and a tiny wire format for runtime -> telemetry ingest.

liam: SG. Are we scoped to per-route + per-model granularity only, or do we need per-customer and per-deployment as well?

sasha: start minimal: per-route, per-model, canary_tag, and a few slice keys (prompt_type, seq_len_bucket). We can add customer/deployment later but watch cardinality.

maya: +1. Also want cost-ish signals included so console can show unit economics in the compare view (tokens, gpu_ms).

andrew: question: how do we want to encode canary/control? a boolean, or an enum so we can support weighted canaries?

jordi: enum is better, e.g. "variant":"control|canary|canary-50pct" — keeps expandability.

liam: here's a tiny suggested wire snippet (runtime -> telemetry):
```json
{
  "metric": "rollout.request_latency.p50",
  "route": "/v1/chat",
  "model": "rw-alpha-7b",
  "variant": "canary",
  "sample_rate": 0.25,
  "tags": {"prompt_type":"instruction","seq_len_bucket":"0-128"},
  "value_ms": 42,
  "tokens": 84
}
```

sasha: perfect. couple of asks: (1) telemetry ingestion needs a sampled boolean for stateful KV cache hits vs cold-starts, (2) instrument count of prefix cache hits as a separate metric.

maya: can we add "cache_state":"warm|cold|partial" to tags? that keeps cardinality low.

andrew: note on sampling: platform dashboards want deterministic sampling for A/B comparisons (same sample decision across downstream metrics). we should hash request_id -> sample bucket and attach sample_bucket value.

liam: agreed — we can add "sample_bucket": 0..999 and have platform map buckets to percentiles.

metrics-bot: ingest-contract v0.2 published: https://go/internal/telemetry/rollout-contract — includes variant enum, sample_bucket, minimal tag set, and cost fields. :white_check_mark:

jordi: perf/ops note: runtime will emit a coarse histogram for latency + a p50/p95 pusher to telemetry. but we should avoid pushing high-cardinality histograms per-customer by default.

sasha: UX ask from console: compare panel needs (a) paired p50/p95 lines by variant, (b) regression flag if >10% relative increase in p95 and p50 both, (c) ability to filter by prompt_type.

maya: regression flag should be tied to confidence window; ops want a minimum sample count (e.g., 500 requests) before we trigger.

andrew: add a derived metric: "rollout.regression_score" = weighted delta_p95 + delta_p50 normalized by baseline variance. We'll prototype in dashboard.

liam: implementation blocker: runtime currently tags metrics as freeform strings; need a thin adapter to normalize tags to the agreed enum set before emit. I'll pair with eng-platform to add a validation layer.

sasha: action items:
- liam + platform: build tag-normalizer middleware and add sample_bucket hashing (owner: liam, due: next Wed).
- andrew + console: add regression_score proto and canary compare panel wireframe (owner: andrew, due: Tue).
- maya + q/infra: confirm token/gpu_ms compute in runtime and expose as metrics (owner: maya, due: Fri).
- jordi: add cache_state dims and histogram knobs (owner: jordi, due: next Mon).

deploy-bot: canary/v2 rollout started on group-us-east-2 (id: canary-2024-11-07-17).

sasha: thanks all. I'll create a short spec doc and link it in the ingest-contract. if anyone wants to sketch dashboard mocks drop them in #product or ping me. :thumbsup:
